# A transaction split stating an amount its currency cannot hold.
#
# 2.005 CAD is half a cent. The same rule that governs a payment block's split
# lines governs this one: a figure the file states is honoured or refused,
# never adjusted, because rounding it to 2.01 would put a number in the books
# that nobody wrote. (A figure this tool *computes* is different — 45.00 USD at
# 1.405 CAD/USD simply is 63.225, and GnuCash takes it to the cent.)
#
# What this fixture produces: the import is refused, naming the amount and the
# currency that cannot state it. Booking it instead costs the entry twice over
# — the split lands as 2.00, and `$residual$`, which takes what the others
# leave, absorbs the missing half cent as 8.00 rather than 7.995.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_payment_split_must_be_consumed.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Bank Fees
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Other
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

2026-02-01 * "Fee stated in half cents"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank -10.00 CAD
	Expenses:Bank Fees 2.005 CAD
	Expenses:Other $residual$ CAD
